flow flow.bare v1
title: Bare steps
start: blink
step blink [Timer] Blink
  stage: -
  does: Waits 1 second.
  next: When the time comes: go to Pause
step pause [Timer] Pause
  stage: -
  does: Waits 30 seconds.
  next: When the time comes: go to Judge
step judge [Decision] Judge
  stage: -
  does: Judges with the rule `conf.default_rule`. The result field `level` says where the flow goes.
  on:high: If `level` is high: go to Fine
  on:low: If `level` is low: go to Fine
  onNoDecision: If the rule gives no result: go to Fine
  onError: If the rule cannot be applied: go to Fine
step fine [End] Fine
  stage: -
  does: Ends the case with the result Fine.
